topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I just found out the apartment I've called home for years is turning into condos. It’s like the familiar rug being pulled out from under my feet. All those late-night movies and weekend brunches on the balcony, they might just be memories soon. The thought of packing up, of searching for a new place, it feels overwhelming. I’m not sure where I’d go, or if anywhere else could feel like this place has. The quiet hum of the city at night, the warmth of the sun through the living room window, it’s more than just a home—it’s been a sanctuary. Now, I have to start thinking about the Practicalities, the next steps, but the idea of walking away from all this, it’s hard to grasp.
